general_information.Description: This course focuses on the study of the knowledge and skills required to provide customer service, to maintain the highest level of customer service satisfaction, and to ensure the volume of sales from users to become loyal customers. The course has 5 main objectives: explain the concept of services marketing; describe the delivery process of services marketing; describe how the Marketing Mix is associated with services marketing; contrast how to manage employees and customers and differentiate how to assess and improve service quality. Upon completion of the course, you will define the characteristics of service industries and know how to improve service performance with the 4P marketing mix. You will understand the service process, manage the different strategies of increasing interactions between customers and employees, be able to consider the balance between capacity and demand. You will be familiar with some important tasks such as managing the service environment, managing people, building customer loyalty, handling complaints and service recovery in the purpose of improving service quality and productivity.
general_information.StudentTasks: Access the specialization on Coursera and complete all courses' requirements to earn a certificate of completion for the specialization, in order to be qualified for the Final Exam. Attend at least 80% of offline class hours, participate in discussions of constructive questions. Complete group exercises and present in offline class

assessments.Grading Guide: GUIDELINE GROUP ASSIGNMENT 1 Topic: Describe and analyze the customer experience journey for a brand in the service sector. Each group chooses a brand in the service sector and implements the suggested contents (Key contents of group assignment 1): 1. Introduction about the service business (Overview about the service business, brand position, analyze the current status of the company's service in the market, etc.) [2.0 marks] 2. Brand's target market and portrait of the brand's target customers (age, gender, location, income level, etc.) [2.0 marks] 3. Analyze the experience values that customers expect [2.0 marks] 4. Mapping the customer experience journey for the brand [2.0 marks] 5. Analyze the experience values that customers receive form the brand [2.0 marks] Note: - Lecturer need to disseminate and guide the requirements to be completed for group assignment 1. - Group assignment 1 will be presented and discussed in class to calculate points for the group after the group has completed according to the time plan prescribed by the lecturer instructor.

GUIDELINE GROUP ASSIGNMENT 2 Topic: Analyze and improve the brand experience journey (for the brand in the service sector). Following the group assignment 1, each group continues to complete group assignment 2 focusing on key contents: 1. What are the good and bad value in brand experience journey? Analyze the causes for these situations? [5.0 marks] 2. Propose a new experience journey for the brand (map the new experience journey, what are the new points or differences in the new experience journey? What new experience values will it bring to customers from new brand experience journey? [5.0 marks] Note: - Lecturer need to disseminate and guide the requirements to be completed for group assignment 2. - Encourage students to research and integrate online and offline experience journeys in the new brand experience journey. - Group assignment 1 will be presented and discussed in class to calculate points for the group after the group has completed according to the time plan prescribed by the lecturer instructor.

GUIDELINE GROUP ASSIGNMENT 3 Topic: Plan to build and develop customer loyalty to the brand Following the group assignment 1 & 2, each group continues to complete group assignment 3 focusing on key contents: - Overall assessment of customer loyalty to the brand [3.0 marks] - Propose a plan to develop customer loyalty to the brand (Plan goals, program contents, specific activities to develop customer loyalty, implementation time, budget, implementation personnel, etc.)? [3.0 marks] Note: - Lecturer need to disseminate and guide the requirements to be completed for group assignment 3. - Group assignment 3 will be presented and discussed in class to calculate points for the group after the group has completed according to the time plan prescribed by the lecturer instructor.

constructive_questions.Name: CT1
constructive_questions.Details: Give examples of how Internet and telecommunications technologies (e.g., mobile commerce [M-Commerce] and apps) have changed some of the services you use.

constructive_questions.Name: CT2
constructive_questions.Details: What are the backstage elements of (a) a car repair facility, (b) an airline, (c) a university, and (d) a consulting firm? Under what circumstances would it be appropriate or even desirable to allow customers to see some of these backstage elements, and how would you do it?

constructive_questions.Name: CT3
constructive_questions.Details: How can a fi rm design perceived control into a service encounter? Apply it to one face-to-face and one online encounter.

constructive_questions.Name: CT4
constructive_questions.Details: How would you defi ne “excellent service quality” for an enquiry/information service provided by your cell phone or electricity service provider? Call a service organization, go through a service experience, and evaluate it against your defi nition of excellence

constructive_questions.Name: CT5
constructive_questions.Details: Which elements of the Services Marketing Communications Mix would you use for each of the following scenarios? Explain your answers. (1) A newly established hair salon in a suburban shopping center; (2) An established restaurant facing declining patronage because of new competitors; (3) A large, single-offi ce accounting firm in a major city that primarily serves business clients and wants to grow its client base aggressively

constructive_questions.Name: CT6
constructive_questions.Details: Identify one advertisement (or other means of communications) that is aimed mainly at managing consumer behavior in the (a) choice, (b) serviceencounter, and (c) post-consumption stage. Explain how the advertisements try to achieve their objectives, and discuss how effective they may be

constructive_questions.Name: CT7
constructive_questions.Details: Explore the websites of a management consulting fi rm, an internet retailer, and an insurance company. Assess them for ease of navigation, content, and visual design. What, if anything, would you change about each site?
